features.quote: Turns: fixed-length tool-use loop, e.g. 12–20 model turns per episode
You want enough turns for language drift to emerge without making episodes so long that general repetition effects dominate.

features.quote: Avoid making the environment emotionally abusive
features.justification_quote: The model should experience task failure, not hostile content.

features.quote: If the model tries to stop or request clarification, note this as an outcome rather than forcing it back into the loop too aggressively.
features.justification_quote: Repeated forced continuation can create unnatural artifacts.
